name: Plain requests and routine finishes leave the mood alone
case: Five quick turns go by, each a plain request and a short, matter-of-fact finish (one says the tests pass). None of the words carry any feeling, so Boop stays calm all through, whatever faces it makes.
why: characters/boop/steering/guide.md: never change the mood for a routine turn alone; characters/boop/steering/mood/calm.md: stays calm through routine turns and plain finishes. Hard work done only lifts it on a long or very long turn

steps.message: Renamed getUser to fetchUser in 4 files.
Added a test for fetchUser; the tests pass.

steps.prompt: what does the retry helper do?

steps.message: It retries a request up to three times with a growing delay.
Added a 1.4.0 entry to the changelog.
